title: Ghosts on the Glass
style: Cinematic painted key art for a modern real-time strategy game, the look of classic Command and Conquer box art: dramatic light, rich colour, crisp detail, wide 16:9 composition, no text, no logos, no letters, no flags, no insignia.

music.caption: tense nocturnal electronic underscore, soft synth pulses like a radar sweep, low strings and a distant piano motif, a held breath, rising to a firm resolve at the end, no vocals

shots.prompt: A harbour city on a calm bay at night: warm lights along the quay reflected on the water, fishing boats moored at a pier, a low dark headland across the bay with three faint cold white strobe lights on tall masts, quiet but uneasy, wide establishing shot.
shots.line: Two days later, on another coast, a harbour city's picture starts to fill.

shots.prompt: Close-up of a green military radar display in a dark command room: a harbour coastline drawn in thin glowing lines and nine bright contact markers converging on it, one marker flickering like an old film frame, reflections of a seated operator on the glass.
shots.line: Nine contacts are closing on the harbour. Most of them are not there.

shots.prompt: Families with children and elderly people walking calmly down lit concrete steps into a public shelter in a harbour city at night, a volunteer in a plain jacket holding the door, warm light inside, orderly and safe, seen from a respectful distance.
shots.line: The families go down to the shelters. Above them, nobody fires until somebody has looked.

shots.prompt: Keep this woman's face, hair and uniform exactly. Portrait of a fictional Israeli army lieutenant colonel, a woman in her forties, dark hair in a low knot, olive field uniform, a headset around her neck and binoculars on a strap, standing in a harbour command room at night lit by green screens, focused and sceptical expression, looking at the viewer, cinematic rim light, painted portrait.
shots.line: Lieutenant Colonel Maya Ronen trusts nothing she has not seen twice.

shots.prompt: Three matte black glass relay masts on a dark rocky headland across a bay at night, each with a single cold white strobe light, faint ghostly shapes of ships shimmering in the air above the water between them like an old film frame, ominous.
shots.line: Find what paints the ghosts. Verify, then strike.
